model_annotation: Figure 3(a) presents a bar chart comparing the inference time (in seconds) across three distinct model configurations — Llama-1B, Llama-1B, and MambaInLlama-1B — as a function of batch size. The x-axis, labeled “Batch size,” is linear and spans discrete values: 1, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 300. The y-axis, labeled “Inference time (seconds),” is linear and ranges from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Three colored bars are plotted at each batch size: blue for Llama-1B, orange for Llama-1B, and red for MambaInLlama-1B. At batch size 1, the blue bar (Llama-1B) reaches approximately 3.6 seconds, the orange bar (Llama-1B) is at 1.1 seconds, and the red bar (MambaInLlama-1B) is at 1.1 seconds. As batch size increases, all three models show a general upward trend in inference time. At batch size 300, the blue bar reaches approximately 9.5 seconds, the orange bar reaches 4.7 seconds, and the red bar reaches 4.7 seconds. The chart visually indicates that MambaInLlama-1B and Llama-1B exhibit nearly identical inference times across all batch sizes, both significantly lower than Llama-1B at larger batch sizes.
